description.en: Marginal tax rate for the first (lowest) band of the progressive French personal income tax schedule (Table 2.77), currently 0%, applied to taxable income up to $tin_upthres1 (11 496 EUR in 2025). It is used as the Band_Rate parameter in the SchedCalc "Gross income tax (before any IMAX corrections)" function of tin_fr and again in tinkt_fr's SchedCalc "Imax: New gross tax using new QF" (which recomputes gross tax using an adjusted family quotient for the Plafonnement du quotient familial correction).

explanation.en: EUROMOD function group: Paramteres of the income tax
